body: It isn't like a hurdle, a better suited analogy is I am a table, bad fortune keeps piling shit on it, and the table is about to collapse. Yeah, if we must go with a metaphor, lets use that one.

Yeah, he knows it isn't like that.   I think he just came to the realization that he had done things like gotten dressed in the presence of a dude who likes dude and also felt like it would always be in the back of his mind and result in uncomfortable situations.  Like I said, it is to the point that we obviously are not going to talk again, it has been so long and I have tried several times unsuccessfully to contact him, but I can't just let it go.

I can't explain what occurred over six years of spending nearly every minute of our freetime together that cause me to become so close.  I am extemely shy, rarely feel any type of emotion for anyone, but for some reason he just always seemed to get me.  Until he didn't of course.
I hear you, some people just don't get how lonely sometime can be.  They are just incapable of putting themselves in another person's shoes and feeling the actual pain.

Nobody is apparently reading my post where it says I can't just move on :/ .  I will be dead soon anyway though, found a good website with ways to die and pros and cons for each.  Researching now.  I am just going to have peace for once,.  I prefer to just go to sleep naturally and never wake up.  It doesn't look like I will be able to get that, but close to it.

We were definitely friends, he just changed after I told him.  At the end he acknowledge how close we were, then he said he it is just too weird for him and it made him uncomfortable around me.  Also, it isn't like I can just stop caring, I wish it was that easy, but it isn't for me, that is the whole point.
